patch_description:
Enhance the ANSATZ_SPEC by adding a final RZ rotation layer (8 parameters). This provides per-qubit phase adjustments that work synergistically with the global gain/bias readout calibration. The final RZ layer allows each qubit to independently tune its phase before measurement, effectively increasing expressivity and helping the model achieve finer margin control without requiring changes to the fixed readout code.

The structure becomes:
- RY layer (8 params for initial superposition)
- CRX circular entanglement (8 params)
- CZ diagonal couplings (0 params)
- RZ final layer (8 params for per-qubit phase tuning)

Total: 24 params per block (up from 16), keeping the model compact while adding flexibility.
